dday.name: Name
todayLines:
The practice time you put in
isn't going anywhere.
Today, trust that time and step on stage.

What you built in the practice room
comes out as sound today.
Share what you prepared,
and that's enough.

Today isn't for making something new.
It's for bringing out
what's already in your hands.

Time on stage is short,
but the road here was long.
Remember how far you've come.
